description: dod.mark refused as a shape error because its params name an identity key: the actor is stamped by the daemon from the CONNECTION, never read from params — and a DoD mark is the person's act (the pairing backstop says a manual mark is a user's), so a param that names the actor would let a caller forge the very identity the backstop checks. The refusal happens before the seam is even asked.

error.message: invalid params: dod.mark params carry "actor" — the actor is stamped by the daemon from the connection, never named by the caller
